payload.blocks: Phase 2 (release and live cargo probe) of plan 261124-2320-claude-worker-allowed-tools; the plan cannot close until it runs. Other plans are not blocked.
payload.headline: Claude worker grant: who stages the release from main (>= 29dd50475) and runs the full suites?

parts.cause: Confined sessions (the lead and this supervisor) cannot build the native addon or the Rust workspace. The skill routes such work to the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session, but `fgos identity resolve lead:SUPERVISOR` finds no live session, so nobody can do it without you.

options.cost: About 1 minute of your time; roughly 30-60 minutes of machine time for build and suites.
options.does: You open one unconfined session named lead:SUPERVISOR; the supervisor then sends it the exact build, stage, activate and test commands and the probe, and closes the plan on the result.
options.gain: Reusable for every later confined-build wait (heads-operate-without-owner phase 7 and delete-dead-node phase 10 will need the same).
options.harm: One more live session to keep running.
options.label: Start an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session

options.does: You run the release build, stage and activate from main, npm test and cargo test --workspace, then tell the supervisor; it starts the live probe.
options.harm: Ties you to the terminal for the build and suite run.
options.label: Run it yourself now

options.cost: None now; the same work later.
options.does: The plan stays running with phase 2 parked; its lead is stopped to free a lead slot.
options.harm: The grant is not proven live and stays unreleased.
options.label: Defer phase 2

parts.recommendation: Start an unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session: the same confined-build wall will hit two other running plans soon, and one session answers all of them.

scope.allows: Staging and activating a release from current main, running the full npm and cargo suites, and the one live cargo probe for this plan.
scope.forbids: Any code change, widening the grant beyond cargo/node/npm test, or landing anything outside this plan's report.

parts.what: Phase 1 landed (29dd50475): the standard claude-cli-bwrap invocation now grants the confined claude worker cargo, node and npm test. Phase 2 needs a release staged and activated from main at or after 29dd50475, full npm test and cargo test --workspace green there, then one live `cargo --version` probe through fgos run.
